title: Planzer says delivery data and portal credentials were stolen in a cyberattack; Digitec Galaxus customers affected
date_note: bluewin says Digitec Galaxus announced the incident 'on Wednesday' (25 November); the articles give no earlier day for the attack itself.
geo_basis: Planzer's seat in Schwyz as given by watson.ch
summary: Swiss transport company Planzer was hit by a cyberattack, according to bluewin and watson relaying the companies' statements. Digitec Galaxus says affected data for its customers includes parcel numbers, names, delivery addresses and email addresses, and in some cases phone numbers, and that its own systems were not affected. Planzer says customer-portal login credentials were stolen but encrypted, and that it has informed the federal cybersecurity and data protection authorities.
plain: Hackers took delivery data from the carrier Planzer, including data on Digitec Galaxus orders. Galaxus says its own systems were not affected.
exec: A delivery partner's breach exposed Digitec Galaxus customers' names, addresses and parcel numbers, according to the companies.
action: Digitec Galaxus warns of fraudulent emails, text messages and phone calls about parcel deliveries; watson reports it advises never giving personal or payment data by SMS, phone or email to complete a delivery.

validation.note: bluewin.ch and watson.ch, two publishers, each relay Planzer's and Digitec Galaxus's statements on the theft; neither company's own notice was read.
